article_title: How a civil servant got away with juggling five jobs for so long

tasks.prompt: What central institutional weakness does the report identify in explaining how Kashim Chowdhury held overlapping government jobs?
options: Civil Service recruitment is managed by private contractors
The payroll system excludes remote employees
All departments share one database but rarely check it
Departments make hiring decisions through HR systems that are not fully joined up
tasks.correct_answer: Departments make hiring decisions through HR systems that are not fully joined up
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מצביעה על מערכת משאבי אנוש שאינה מרוכזת ועל החלטות גיוס נפרדות בין משרדים, ולכן הכפילויות לא זוהו.

tasks.prompt: What combination of jobs was reported for May 2023?
options: Five full-time roles totalling 183 contracted hours a week
Three part-time roles totalling 80 hours a week
Eight simultaneous roles in private companies
Two Civil Service posts plus freelance consulting
tasks.correct_answer: Five full-time roles totalling 183 contracted hours a week
tasks.explanation_hebrew: במאי 2023 הוא קיבל שכר מחמישה גופים ממשלתיים והיה מחויב ל־183 שעות עבודה שבועיות.

tasks.prompt: How was the suspected fraud finally detected?
options: A line manager searched his personal bank accounts
The National Fraud Initiative matched anomalies in government databases
A colleague saw him enter another department's office
His GP reported several sick-note requests
tasks.correct_answer: The National Fraud Initiative matched anomalies in government databases
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היוזמה הלאומית למניעת הונאה מצאה חריגות באמצעות חיפוש במאגרי שירות המדינה, ובהם נתוני שכר.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “flying under the radar” mean?
options: Working entirely from home
Moving quickly between departments
Receiving special protection from managers
Avoiding notice or scrutiny despite poor performance
tasks.correct_answer: Avoiding notice or scrutiny despite poor performance
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי flying under the radar מתאר מי שאינו מושך תשומת לב או בדיקה, אף שיש בעיה בהתנהלותו.

tasks.prompt: Why was the Defra manager's evidence especially damaging to Chowdhury's case?
options: It showed poor performance and repeated camera excuses, yet he still obtained a permanent post
It proved he had never worked for Defra
It showed he disclosed all his other jobs during recruitment
It established that remote working was prohibited at Defra
tasks.correct_answer: It showed poor performance and repeated camera excuses, yet he still obtained a permanent post
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העדות תיארה צורך להנחות אותו ללא הרף והימנעות ממצלמה במשך חודשים, ובכל זאת היעדר מדדי ביצוע פורמליים אפשר קביעות.

tasks.prompt: What does “polygamous working” refer to in this article?
options: Sharing one role between several employees
Moving between government departments openly
Secretly holding several jobs at the same time
Working for both government and a trade union
tasks.correct_answer: Secretly holding several jobs at the same time
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בכתבה המונח מתייחס להחזקה סמויה בכמה משרות במקביל, בלי ליידע את המעסיקים.

tasks.prompt: Explain how remote work and sick notes helped Chowdhury conceal an impossible schedule.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין עבודה מלאה מהבית, היעדר נוכחות פיזית, ימי מחלה במשרות קיימות והתחלת משרה נוספת.
expected_points: He worked entirely from the home he shared with his mother, reducing direct observation by employers
He used sick notes to be absent from several departments
While absent from existing roles, he could begin or continue other employment
Camera-off claims and separate departmental oversight further reduced scrutiny

tasks.prompt: Summarise in 4–5 sentences how individual deception and Civil Service systems combined to let the fraud continue.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב פעולות מרמה אישיות עם לפחות שני כשלים מערכתיים, ולציין כיצד התגלה המקרה.
expected_points: Chowdhury failed to declare existing Civil Service employment on applications
He used sick leave, remote work and explanations for absences to manage overlapping roles
Decentralised HR and hiring systems did not identify duplicate employment
Weak performance management allowed problems to persist
The National Fraud Initiative later detected database anomalies

tasks.prompt: What broader criticism of Civil Service performance management is supported by the survey and the unnamed former senior official?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את נתון הסקר עם ההסבר התרבותי על הימנעות מניהול ביצועים והפחד מהשלכות.
expected_points: In the Re:State survey, 76% of 1,700 respondents said the Civil Service did not tackle poor performers well
The former official described a culture that is risk-averse about performance management
Managers may fear lengthy grievances or criticism over the cost of settlements
The evidence suggests poor performance can remain unaddressed for too long

tasks.prompt: Write a concise evidence-based paragraph proposing two controls that address the specific failures described in the report.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שני אמצעים הקשורים ישירות לכשלים שבכתבה ולהסביר בקצרה כיצד כל אחד היה מצמצם את הסיכון.
expected_points: A joined-up cross-department HR or payroll check could flag overlapping full-time employment
More frequent data matching could reduce the delay between National Fraud Initiative searches
Formal performance measures and consistent follow-up could expose persistent non-performance
The response should link each proposed control to a documented weakness in the case
